css: .print-format{page-size:Custom;page-width:148mm;page-height:105mm;margin:0;width:148mm!important;max-width:148mm!important;min-height:105mm!important;height:105mm!important;padding:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;overflow:hidden}@page{size:148mm 105mm;margin:0}html,body{width:148mm;height:105mm;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000}.bin-card{width:148mm;height:105mm;border:1.4mm solid #000;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4mm;display:grid;grid-template-rows:11mm 16mm 49mm 13mm 5mm;gap:1mm;overflow:hidden}.card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:1mm solid #000;font-size:15px}.card-head b{font-size:18px}.card-head span{font-weight:900;border:1px solid #000;padding:1mm 3mm}.identity{font-size:34px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}.card-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 49mm;gap:5mm}.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3mm}.facts div{border:.5mm solid #000;padding:2mm;overflow:hidden}.facts small{display:block;font-size:8px;font-weight:800}.facts b{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.2;white-space:normal}.qr{text-align:center;border-left:.8mm solid #000;padding-left:4mm}.qr img{width:40mm;height:40mm}.qr strong{display:block;font-size:9px}.barcode{height:13mm;border-top:.5mm solid #000;padding-top:1mm}.barcode svg{width:100%;height:100%}.footer{text-align:center;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.5px}@media screen{.print-format{width:148mm!important;max-width:148mm!important;min-height:105mm!important;height:105mm!important;padding:0!important}.print-format-gutter{padding:10px 0!important}}
